source_snapshot.items: All HDD Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert all approved NVMe SSDs into the backplane and check each NVMe-adapter slot number.
source_snapshot.criteria: Observed slot numbers match the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES proposes lsblk, /dev/nvme* enumeration and truncated nvme id-ctrl over unsafe SSH, which cannot establish physical-slot identity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED with HIGH physical/storage risk; require qualified operator, complete serial-to-slot topology, supported insertion procedure and full PCI/sysfs/controller evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only enumeration can inventory devices but device order and partial identify output do not prove chassis slot number.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves all-NVMe physical placement while adding stable identity, topology, operator and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Locate and other LED rows validate indicators; this row independently validates physical-to-logical slot numbering for every NVMe target.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Each drive must be reconciled by stable identity to one documented physical label and controller path; no ordinal inference is allowed.

original_test_intent: Verify every approved NVMe SSD occupies and reports the system-specified backplane/adapter slot number.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and photographs every mapped SSD; the agent correlates stable serial/NGUID identity with complete controller, PCI and sysfs topology against the approved slot map.
manual_activity: User approves the topology and handling plan; qualified operator inserts and photographs each SSD; agent reconciles stable identity and complete topology evidence.
required_inputs: Complete SSD serial/WWN/NGUID to backplane/adapter/controller/BDF/slot map
Supported power or hot-swap, RAID/data/boot and recovery procedure
Qualified operator and physical label/photo access
Pinned inventory/topology tools, secure access, OOB and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Exclude production, boot, mounted and unapproved array members from handling
Validate every serial and target slot before insertion
Stop on wrong mapping, connector damage, enumeration loss, RAID/filesystem/thermal/power/BMC error or recovery loss
Preserve full evidence and non-target state
Do not infer a physical slot from /dev/nvme order or manipulate hardware remotely
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete pre/post inventory, topology and health
Correlate stable SSD identity with operator-recorded physical labels
Produce an expected-versus-observed row for every target
Do not perform physical insertion, infer labels, repair storage or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve topology, population and recovery plan
Provide qualified operator and resolve ambiguous slot evidence
Review each drive mapping and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lsblk and nvme-cli help inventory drives, but /dev/nvme order and truncated id-ctrl output cannot establish physical backplane/adapter slot number.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete stable NVMe identity, controller/BDF, sysfs physical-slot and namespace evidence and correlate it with operator photos and the approved platform map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-NVMe insertion, adapter slot-number check and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a per-drive stable identity-to-physical-label-to-controller-path matrix before handling, then collect complete post-insertion evidence for every row.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable stable identity, topology, safety and recovery evidence without changing all-drive slot coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation verifies logical topology; qualified observation remains mandatory for physical placement.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS/controller enumeration can change and some platforms expose no trustworthy physical-slot attribute.

project_override_considerations: Use only the project-approved physical slot authority and vendor controller/backplane topology; Linux names and controller ordinals are not interchangeable with chassis labels.
expected_evidence: Operator identity, insertion order, timestamps and photos
Per-drive comparison, final population/recovery state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require all-NVMe slot-number validation; HDD grouping terminology does not replace the literal NVMe scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, operator, tools and safe insertion plan are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Replaces unreliable device-order inference with a stable per-drive physical/logical topology reconciliation and protected handling contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Linux NVMe index reflects discovery order, not a chassis slot, and can change after reboot or service. Correctness therefore requires an independent physical label plus stable drive identity and PCI/controller path for every SSD; incomplete identity output cannot prove that mapping.
